dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Lord Barbatos has indeed heard our prayers. Mondstadt is safe once again.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Although I say that it is over, Dvalin's influence will likely remain for a while longer...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: But I believe that as long as the winds of Mondstadt persist, Lord Barbatos will always be with us.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: ...Perhaps he is already amongst us. Who can say?
